notes.title: Game Update Log 7.22
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyːI am very honored to report the updated content with you again. The game updates during this period are as follows:
Backpack system update: Standardize the backpack UI and add one-click merging to avoid the problem of too many backpack items.
Added customizable FPS limit: prevent the game from taking up too many of your resources.
Synthesis interface: Create a synthesis interface and options
Expected updates before release:
Improve the synthesis function: The current synthesis is not perfect. There is no custom ball to use for synthesis. It is in the default order. Now we are making it possible to choose to use specific balls for synthesis.
Mini game function: After the game goes online, popular mini games on the Internet will be added, and you can get drop rewards after playing.
Stay tuned for more content!

notes.title: Balls Game Major Update Preview!
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyː We are honored to introduce this game update to you. The current game has undergone significant changes from the initial version.

We spent half a month restructuring the UI and system. The game now includes the following content.

[h3]【Redefinition of Item Quality】[/h3]
We have redefined the quality of items in the game, dividing them into the following five tiers:

[list]
[*] 【Impurities】-- Products of failed synthesis, can be used to synthesize bundles.
[*] 【Ordinary】-- Can be obtained through free in-game bundles/clicking balls/daily logins, can be used to synthesize rarer balls.
[*] 【Rare】-- Can be obtained through ball synthesis/free in-game bundles/daily logins/store purchases, can be used to synthesize rarer balls.
[*] 【Treasure】-- Can be obtained through ball synthesis/free in-game bundles/daily logins/store purchases, most treasure balls have special effects [e.g., additional balls over time, slightly increased synthesis probability, etc.].
[*] 【Legendary】-- Can be obtained through ball synthesis/special events, legendary balls have powerful special effects [e.g., additional rare or higher-tier balls, significantly increased synthesis probability, exclusive event tickets, etc.].
[/list]

[h3]【Game Bundles】[/h3]
Now, every 3 hours, you can claim a mysterious bundle in the game [no need to be online]. Opening this bundle will grant you a certain number of balls [1-5 balls of either 【Ordinary】【Rare】【Treasure】 quality].

[h3]【Clicking Balls for Extra Balls】[/h3]
Now, clicking the ball in the center of the screen may grant you balls [1 ball of either 【Ordinary】【Rare】 quality].

[h3]【Synthesis System】[/h3]
You can now use balls of 【Impurities】 quality or higher to synthesize higher-quality balls [there is a chance of failure, failed synthesis results in 【Impurities】 balls].

[h3]【Inventory System】[/h3]
You can open the inventory to view the quantity, name, description, and effects of each ball. You can also set which ball to display in the inventory interface.

[h3]【Shop System】[/h3]
You can purchase your desired balls in the shop.

[h3]【Language System】[/h3]
The game now supports Simplified Chinese and English [more languages will be supported gradually in the future], and you can freely switch languages in the settings.

[h3]【Ball Display】[/h3]
You can replace the ball in the center of the game interface with the balls you obtained, some of which provide additional effects.

This concludes the update. Thank you for watching. We plan to open some test qualifications soon. During the beta test period, you can obtain high-quality exclusive balls. If you have any questions, please leave us a message in the comments.

notes.title: Game release trailer
notes.content:
Hello, players!ːsteamhappyː
 I am the developer of this game. Let me introduce this game to you. The game has the following game content:

[h2]Quality differences:[/h2]
Ordinary Ball, the function is to use multiple to synthesize rare Ball
Rare Ball, [u]can be collected or synthesized into Legendary Ball [tentative content may be changed later][/u]
Legendary Ball, the holder of Legendary Ball can directly obtain event Ball and event objects in most peripheral activities, such as plush toy peripherals, etc. [u]And it can shorten the time to obtain Ball [tentative content may be changed later[/u]] [u]or obtain multiple Balls at a time [tentative content may be changed later].[/u]

[h2]Item drop mechanism:[/h2]
After playing the game for the first time, [u]a Ball will be dropped every 24 hours [tentative content may be changed later], with a 95% chance of dropping a common Ball and a 5% chance of dropping a rare Ball
[/u]
[h2]Item synthesis mechanism:[/h2]
[u]You can use 10 common Balls for a synthesis, with a 99.5% chance of getting a rare Ball and a 0.5% chance of getting a legendary Ball [tentative content may be changed later]
Please look forward to more synthesis possibilities.
[/u]
[h2]Game archive mechanism:[/h2]
The number of times you click will be retained, and we will hold events from time to time to give players with a certain number of clicks out of print rare Balls!
